carrier.note: D01 selects origins only; the fixed-head response probe is not opened in this work unit.

eligibility.held_out_policy: HELD_OUT state observables are excluded from parsing/selection to preserve the ROM firewall.
eligibility.same_time: candidate pair T fields must be text-identical and parse to the same IEEE binary64 value

observable_reconstruction.upper_30cm_water_cm: sum(theta_i * 10 cm), i=1..3; descriptive only, not a pair gate

frozen_h2_state_gate.provenance: physical conversion of RZM06A thresholds after RZM06A6 unit audit

selection_rule.candidate_generation: all unordered eligible state pairs with same T and different HISTORY
selection_rule.no_match: Close D01 as NO_MATCH. Do not loosen thresholds, expose held-out states, admit fallback states or inspect E_c.

persistence_if_selected: persist selected A/B provenance, time, reconstructed W_profile, M1 and upper-30cm water
persist all 16 pressure_head and theta values for both origins
persist artifact authority/digest and selector version
do not persist or inspect state-line response/exchange fields
next_if_selected: GC-RZM06D02 preregisters exact reconstruction of the selected two committed origins and identical forcing-free fixed-Hc Reference probes.
controls: D01 performs no HeadCalc solve and no E_c probe
D01 does not change ROM library or H2 thresholds
D01 excludes all FALLBACK=T states from the primary selection
selected pair is immutable for D02; D02 cannot reselect after seeing probe behavior
nonclaims: D01 does not support or falsify H2 by itself
ROM discovery-state selection does not admit a reduced model or production coupling
B01 homogeneous pure hydraulics is a research falsification carrier, not a deployment profile
